node.title: Re^3: perlcritic compliant way to eval?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi Robert,

'do' ... seemed to work at first for me but is acting wonky

There are some differences between [doc://do] and [doc://eval], maybe that's the problem?

"do 'stat.pl'; is largely like eval `cat stat.pl`; except that it's more concise, runs no external processes, keeps track of the current filename for error messages, searches the [doc://@INC] directories, and updates [doc://%INC] if the file is found. ... It also differs in that code evaluated with do FILE cannot see lexicals in the enclosing scope; eval STRING does."

Also do requires some more error checking to figure out what went wrong if the file doesn't compile/run, see [doc://do].

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
